title: Tracy QA layer denominator
description: What one layer is responsible for: items, the edge tags each item owes, the tags that do not apply (with a reason and a source) and what the extraction could not resolve. The same shape for every layer; tests/qa/lib/denominator.mjs adds the rules a schema cannot express (kinds and tags per layer, N-A grammar, unique ids).

revision.description: What the extraction was taken from: a commit (the only form coverage can prove fresh), a content hash, or null when unknown.

naReasons.description: Every N-A reason once: key -> "<reason>; source: <reference>". `{id}` in a reason stands for the id of the item that cites it. Items point here from `na`, so a reason shared by hundreds of items is written once.

details.description: Layer-specific facts (counts, hashes of sources, coverage tables). Which keys a layer may write is fixed in tests/qa/lib/denominator.mjs.

na.description: tag -> key of the reason in `naReasons`

meta.description: Facts of this kind of item. Which keys a kind may carry is fixed in tests/qa/lib/denominator.mjs.

detail.description: Evidence for the entry (for example the rows that were not read).
